name: Tello Mobile
notes: Researched from the public tello.com Help Center, contact page and plan builder (rendered with a headless browser; no sign-in). Tello is 100% prepaid on 30-day plans with auto-renewal on by default: Autopay runs on day 30 between 5 and 11 AM ET, retries for a few days after a failure, then the plan is suspended (no late fees, no deferral, no payment plans, no advance or future-dated payments). Sign-in uses the email address and password; sign-up also offers Google or Apple accounts (socialProviders [google], google_login supported). Payments: credit/debit cards, PayPal, Venmo, Apple Pay and Google Pay; checks and bank transfers are not accepted (billing.methods [card]). Plan changes take effect immediately and are charged in full, starting a new 30-day cycle (the engine applies the price at the next billing date; GAP). Customers cancel in the online account (Cancel Plan under My Plan) at least 24 hours before renewal; Support cannot cancel for them; service runs to the end of the cycle. No paper bills (invoices are emailed). Plan prices are the published plan-builder prices for unlimited minutes with 2/10/20 GB or unlimited data (the unlimited price is marked as a new-customer rate on its label).

guest_pay.note: Plans are renewed in your online account or the My Tello app.

autopay.note: Autopay renews your 30-day plan on day 30, usually between 5 AM and 11 AM ET. You can turn on a 48-hour reminder under Payment, Subscription Payment Options.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop renewals, select Cancel Plan below My Plan on your Dashboard at least 24 hours before your renewal date.

scheduled_payment.note: Renewals cannot be scheduled for a future date; a manual renewal starts a new 30-day cycle right away.

paperless.note: Tello does not mail bills; your invoice is emailed after each successful renewal.

payment_arrangement.note: Tello is prepaid with no late fees or past-due balances; billing is automated and renewal dates cannot be delayed.

cancel_service.note: Cancel at least 24 hours before your next renewal. Support cannot cancel for you. Service stays active until the end of the current cycle.

change_plan.note: A new plan starts immediately, is charged in full and starts a new 30-day cycle.

google_login.note: Sign up with your email address or with a Google or Apple account.

help.title: When do autopay and plan renewal occur?
paragraphs: Each Tello plan lasts 30 days and Autopay renews it on day 30, usually between 5 AM and 11 AM Eastern. A plan bought on July 5 renews on August 4.

You can ask for a reminder 48 hours before the charge under Payment, Subscription Payment Options. Successful renewals email an invoice; failures send an email and a text. Change your plan at least 24 hours before renewal.
If a renewal fails, Tello retries over the next few days; if every attempt fails the plan is suspended and leftover balances are lost.

help.title: What forms of payment do you accept?
paragraphs: Tello accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover, plus Diners, JCB, Maestro and Visa Electron cards, and PayPal, Venmo, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Checks and bank transfers are not accepted.

help.title: How can I cancel my service?
paragraphs: There is no contract. To keep your number, get your account number and transfer PIN from the Number Transfer page first; balances are forfeited once the port-out completes.

Cancel at least 24 hours before your next renewal: on the Dashboard select Cancel Plan below My Plan, then choose not to park your number. Support cannot cancel for you. Service stays on until the end of the current cycle; turn off Pay As You Go Auto-Recharge separately.

help.title: Tello plans
paragraphs: Plans with unlimited minutes and texts cost $10 (2 GB), $15 (10 GB), $20 (20 GB) or $25 (unlimited data with 50 GB high-speed) a month; the $25 unlimited price is a first-month rate for new customers. Upgrades or downgrades start immediately and are charged in full.
